description: This file is a Node.js script used for performing regression testing on gateway watch functionality by capturing filesystem state, running processes, timing, diffing snapshots, and generating summaries. It contains logic for argument parsing, filesystem snapshotting, process execution, and analysis related to build and runtime behavior within a specific project context.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and merges them with default options.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Creates a directory and all parent directories if they don't exist.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in file paths for consistency.

methods.name: listTreeEntries
methods.description: Recursively lists all files and directories under a root directory.

methods.name: humanBytes
methods.description: Converts a byte count into a human-readable string with units.

methods.name: snapshotTree
methods.description: Generates filesystem statistics for a directory, including counts and sizes.

methods.name: writeSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of specific directories ('dist' and 'dist-runtime') by listing paths and stats, saving as JSON and text files.

methods.name: runCheckedCommand
methods.description: Runs a command synchronously and throws an error if it fails.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves after a specified timeout.

methods.name: buildTimedWatchCommand
methods.description: Builds a command object for running a timed Node.js watch process with environment variables.

methods.name: parseTimingFile
methods.description: Parses the timing output file to extract CPU and elapsed times.

methods.name: runTimedWatch
methods.description: Executes a time-limited watch process, manages PID, captures stdout/stderr, and timing info.

methods.name: parsePathFile
methods.description: Reads a list of file paths from a text file.

methods.name: writeDiffArtifacts
methods.description: Compares pre- and post- snapshot paths, writes added and removed files.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Logs an error message to standard error.

methods.name: detectWatchBuildReason
methods.description: Analyzes stdout/stderr output to determine the reason for a rebuild trigger.

methods.name: buildRunNodeDeps
methods.description: Provides dependencies and paths for running the build process, including environment and configuration files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function orchestrating the regression test workflow, including build, snapshotting, timing, diffing, analysis, and reporting.
